jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Nirvana is on a mission to harness the power of data to revolutionize commercial insurance and enable a safer world. We are bringing much-needed innovation into the legacy, trillion-dollar commercial insurance industry. We have developed cutting-edge predictive models that use real-time IoT data from billions of connected devices, allowing us to better understand and price risk. Our AI-driven platform fundamentally changes the way an insurance company operates with personalized risk scoring, faster underwriting, modernized claims, and proactive, data-driven insights to help customers prevent accidents.



We’ve already proven the scale—serving thousands of fleets and more than doubling our written premiums year over year. Our data moat is growing exponentially with more than 30 billion miles of telematics data, leading to more predictive models and new insights into how we can better understand and reduce risk. Altogether, our loss ratio, efficiency, and customer experience are redefining what can be done in the industry.



With $270+ million raised, including our Series D round in December 2025, we’re only accelerating our growth, with strong support from top-tier VCs including Lightspeed, General Catalyst, and Valor. Nirvana’s leadership team has previously helped scale multi-billion-dollar companies from scratch, including Samsara, Glassdoor, and Flexport, and includes industry veterans from Nationwide, The Hartford, and RLI.

The role
As Chief of Staff, you’d sit at the center of the business and work directly with Rushil on the most strategic initiatives across the company. You’d scale how we operate, solve the most critical problems and define new avenues for growth, especially where ownership is unclear.

This is NOT a coordination role. We’re looking for someone who can operate in ambiguous and demanding environments, holds extremely high standards and has the ability to move from board-level strategy to execution detail without compromise.

For the right person who wants to build, this is the perfect accelerant to owning your own P&L, ideally within Nirvana as we continue to expand or even beyond. Success here isn’t being in this role forever - it’s the opportunity to start something with Rushil’s full backing.



Responsibilities include:

 - Drive clarity around critical decisions, separate signal from noise and follow-through until they become outcomes

 - Own high-priority projects and cross-functional initiatives that don’t have a natural home yet

 - Scale our operating rhythms with a high bar for impact - business reviews, off-sites, planning and more

 - Proactively identify and solve bottlenecks across the company

 - Run board and investor prep, and help shape how we tell our story externally



Who we're looking for

 - 5+ years experience in high-ownership roles: we’re not wedded to a specific pedigree, we want smart generalists from the likes of consulting, finance, product, business operations, military, founder/CEO office, etc. Most important is to have operating experience in fast-moving environments

 - Previous founding experience strongly preferred, even if it didn’t work

 - Strategic and analytical thinker

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

 - Bias-to-action and self-driven: you move fast and build things yourself with an AI-native mindset

 - Thrive in high-growth environments with limited direction

 - Very high judgment and maturity with sensitive, high-stakes information

 - High agency, low ego: you’re willing to do whatever the company needs

 - Executive presence and influence: you can push back, when necessary, on experienced leaders



Benefits

 - Competitive salary & equity

 - Medical, dental & vision insurance (100% employer paid)

 - 401k with up to 4% company match

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Wellness reimbursement



We set our salary ranges using compensation data from companies similar to our stage and size. For this role, the estimated total cash for this position is $180,000- $300,000. The actual total cash salary will vary depending on multiple factors unique to each candidate, including location, job-related knowledge, transferable skills, work experience and our assessment of your level during the interview process. Nirvana offers equity for all full-time employees, which is not included in the range listed above and will have an impact on your overall compensation.

If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We'd like to consider you for this position and roles that may be a fit in the future.

Nirvana is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Nirvana considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Nirvana’s leadership team has previously helped scale multi-billion-dollar companies from scratch, including Samsara, Glassdoor, and Flexport, and includes industry veterans from Nationwide, The Hartford, and RLI.

About the role:
In this role, you'll serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leadership, you'll influence some of the company's most important decisions—from where we invest and how we scale to how we build an AI-native finance organization. You'll work cross-functionally, connecting strategy, finance, operations, and execution to help drive the business forward.

This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. You'll tackle the company's biggest challenges, lead cross-functional initiatives, and help build AI-first systems, processes, and operating rhythms that will define our next stage of growth.

What you’ll do:

 - Partner directly with senior leadership to shape company strategy, driving decisions on growth, investments, capital allocation, and organizational priorities

 - Lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that improve business performance, partnering with leaders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Go-to-Market, Recruiting, and People from identifying opportunities through execution

 - Design the operating rhythms that help the company scale, including planning, forecasting, performance management, and company-wide decision-making processes.

 - Define the company's long-term financial strategy, including fundraising, strategic planning, and/or evaluating new business opportunities.

 - Directly shape how we build an AI-native finance organization, reimagining how AI augments every part of the workflows, from planning, analysis, decision-making, to execution

About you:

 - 4-6 years of experience across management consulting, investment banking, private equity, Strategic Finance or Business Operations roles in high-growth companies

 - Proficiency in complex financial modeling and planning

 - Comfortable working cross-functionally with multiple teams, building strong relationships, and driving alignment in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

 - Demonstrated outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills

 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify and articulate complex financial concepts to diverse stakeholders, from executives to operators.

 - Hands-on operator: comfortable digging into the details with teams, implementing solutions, and iterating quickly - not just producing metrics or analysis.

 - Detail-oriented and execution-focused, with the resilience to thrive in a high-performance, fast-paced setting.

Benefits:

 - Competitive salary & equity

 - Medical, dental & vision insurance

 - 401k with company match

 - Unlimited PTO

 - 3 days/week in SF office

We set our salary ranges using compensation data from companies similar to our stage and size. For this role, the estimated salary range for this position is $140,000 - $160,000. The actual base salary will vary depending on multiple factors unique to each candidate, including location, job-related knowledge, transferable skills, work experience and our assessment of your level during the interview process.

Nirvana offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive benefits for this role including 100% employer paid healthcare plans, a healthy 401k match program, paid time off, parental leave, wellness reimbursement, work-from-home stipend and more.

In addition, Nirvana offers equity for all full-time employees, which is not included in the range listed above and will have a significant impact on your overall compensation.

Nirvana is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Head of Finance
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Nirvana is on a mission to harness the power of data to revolutionize commercial insurance and enable a safer world. We are bringing much-needed innovation into the legacy, trillion-dollar commercial insurance industry. We have developed cutting-edge predictive models that use real-time IoT data from billions of connected devices, allowing us to better understand and price risk. Our AI-driven platform fundamentally changes the way an insurance company operates with personalized risk scoring, faster underwriting, modernized claims, and proactive, data-driven insights to help customers prevent accidents.



We’ve already proven the scale—serving thousands of fleets and more than doubling our written premiums year over year. Our data moat is growing exponentially with more than 30 billion miles of telematics data, leading to more predictive models and new insights into how we can better understand and reduce risk. Altogether, our loss ratio, efficiency, and customer experience are redefining what can be done in the industry.



With $270+ million raised, including our Series D round in December 2025, we’re only accelerating our growth, with strong support from top-tier VCs including Lightspeed, General Catalyst, and Valor. Nirvana’s leadership team has previously helped scale multi-billion-dollar companies from scratch, including Samsara, Glassdoor, and Flexport, and includes industry veterans from Nationwide, The Hartford, and RLI.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

In this role, you'll be the financial owner of Nirvana Insurance Services (NIS), a commercial insurance MGA and the engine of our written premium growth. You'll own its accounting close, revenue recognition, billing operations, reinsurance program economics, and business-unit FP&A end to end.

Today that work sits across several people as one piece of each of their broader, multi-entity roles. As we scale, NIS deserves a single, accountable owner — and this is that seat. You'll report to our CEO, oversee our Accounting, Billing, and FP&A teams, and partner closely with our cross-functional leaders across the company.

This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. You'll build and enhance the processes, source of truth, and the team behind one of the most economically important parts of the company.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own NIS's monthly, quarterly, and annual FP&A cycle — budget-vs-actual for the company and its programs — and author the variance narrative that feeds our board process

 - Own NIS's accounting close and revenue recognition for MGA commission income (ASC 606), including treaty-year commission-rate reconciliation

 - Own NIS's billing operations — premium invoicing, mileage-based installment billing, agency commission netting — across all insurance programs, partnering with the Billing team on execution and serving as the escalation point for billing disputes and cancellations

 - Own premium trust account funding approval and serve as the escalation point for fronting-carrier remittance operations, partnering with our Controller's team on execution

 - Own the reconciliation of NIS's reinsurance program economics — quota share loss ratios and provisional and contingent commission true-ups by treaty year — and build the single, shared source of truth behind them

 - Own financial oversight of our subproducer and agency agreements, from reviewing terms to resolving remittance and commission-balance questions with our agency partners

 - Coordinate NIS's audit deliverables with our external auditors as part of the broader company-wide engagement

 - Author NIS's financial narrative and results for the board deck

 - Serve as the day-to-day financial partner to our Fleet, Business Auto, and Non-Fleet business-unit leads

 - Build and lead a small, high-leverage team, with an accountant, FP&A lead, and billing operations associates


ABOUT YOU:

 - Hands-on experience across both accounting and finance/FP&A inside an operating company of approximately 8 - 12 years

 - Detail-oriented and execution-focused, with the resilience to thrive in a high-performance, fast-paced setting

 - Hands-on operator: comfortable digging into the details with teams, implementing solutions, and iterating quickly — not just producing metrics or analysis

 - Comfortable operating in an environment where entity structures and processes can be complex and navigating those challenges and building the future is energizing

 - Demonstrated outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills

 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify and articulate complex financial concepts to diverse stakeholders, from executives to operators

 - ASC 606 revenue recognition experience, ideally with commission-based revenue models

 - Prior experience in fintech; some fluency in insurance or MGA economics are nice to have experience

 - Experience overseeing billing or invoicing operations is a plus

 - Prior insurance or financial services experience is a nice to have, not a requirement


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive salary & equity

 - Medical, dental & vision insurance

 - 401k with company match

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Remote (U.S.)

We set our salary ranges using compensation data from companies similar to our stage and size. For this role, the estimated salary range for this position is $200K - $280K. The actual base salary will vary depending on multiple factors unique to each candidate, including location, job-related knowledge, transferable skills, work experience and our assessment of your level during the interview process.

Nirvana offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive benefits for this role including 100% employer paid healthcare plans, a healthy 401k match program, paid time off, parental leave, wellness reimbursement, work-from-home stipend and more. In addition, Nirvana offers equity for all full-time employees, which is not included in the range listed above and will have a significant impact on your overall compensation.

About the role:

Reporting to our Head of Corporate Development, you'll be a core member of Nirvana's newly formed Corporate Development team, supporting M&A, strategic investments, and partnerships across the insurance value chain. You'll work closely with Strategic Finance, Insurance and Claims leadership, and your work will directly inform executive and board-level decisions. This is a high-visibility role for someone who wants hands-on deal experience at a fast-growing InsureTech company and the chance to take on more ownership as the function grows.



What you'll do:

 - Build and maintain financial models to evaluate acquisitions, investments, and strategic partnerships, including valuation, returns, and scenario analysis

 - Support due diligence processes across financial, commercial, and operational workstreams, coordinating with internal teams and outside advisors

 - Track the deal pipeline and sourcing initiatives, including market mapping and target screening across the MGA, claims, and data sectors

 - Prepare materials and analysis for executive and board-level discussions, including investment memos and transaction summaries

 - Support deal execution from initial evaluation through closing, helping manage timelines, diligence requests, and integration planning



About you:

 - 2+ years of experience in investment banking, private equity, corporate development, or a related field

 - Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with experience evaluating complex transaction opportunities

 - Familiarity with financial services or FinTech is a plus; insurance or InsureTech experience is a bonus

 - Able to turn complex analysis into clear, concise materials for senior audiences

 - Highly organized and detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple workstreams at once

 - Strong communication skills, both written & verbal

 - Self-starter who independently seeks out opportunities to learn & succeed

 - Bias-to-action: not afraid to get your hands dirty and stretch yourself

 - Owner mentality: takes accountability for actions and results

 - Thrives in high-growth, ambiguous startup environments

 - Able to work full-time in our San Francisco office



Benefits — San Francisco:

- Competitive salary & equity

- Medical, dental & vision insurance (100% employer paid)

- 401k with up to 4% company match
